user.title: New grow light
user.description: Grow Conductor keeps a grow light on for a daily target of hours, but only while nobody can see it.

data_description.name: Device name, e.g. 'Sofakrok plantelys'.
data_description.light_entity: The switch or light that powers the grow light.

signals.title: Visibility signals
signals.description: How the conductor knows whether someone could see the light. Every signal is optional, but with none configured the light will never turn on.

data.viewer_entities: Rooms with a view of the light

data_description.sleep_entity: On while the household sleeps — the prime window for running the light.
data_description.home_entity: A zone, person, tracker or sensor that tells whether anyone is home.
data_description.viewer_entities: Occupancy sensors covering every spot the light is visible from. Any activity here cuts the light immediately (night movement, morning routine).
data_description.refuge_entities: Occupancy sensors for rooms the light is NOT visible from, e.g. a home office. Sustained presence there lets the light run while you are awake at home (working from home).
data_description.veto_entities: Signals that force the light off regardless of occupancy, e.g. the TV in the same room.
data_description.trigger_entities: Entities whose state CHANGES mean someone is moving near the sleep boundary, e.g. the bedroom door contact. Each change cuts the light and starts the quiet-time hold; the state itself is ignored, so a door left open never blocks the schedule.

abort.already_configured: This grow light is already conducted.

data.viewer_entities: Rooms with a view of the light

data_description.sleep_entity: On while the household sleeps — the prime window for running the light.
data_description.home_entity: A zone, person, tracker or sensor that tells whether anyone is home.
data_description.viewer_entities: Occupancy sensors covering every spot the light is visible from.
data_description.refuge_entities: Occupancy in rooms without sight of the light; sustained presence allows daytime runs.
data_description.veto_entities: Signals that force the light off regardless of occupancy.
data_description.trigger_entities: Entities whose state CHANGES mean someone is moving near the sleep boundary, e.g. the bedroom door contact. Each change cuts the light and starts the quiet-time hold; the state itself is ignored, so a door left open never blocks the schedule.

data_description.anchor: When the daily light budget resets — ideally around your usual bedtime.
data_description.clear_hold_seconds: How long the viewed rooms must stay quiet before the light may turn on.
data_description.refuge_confirm_seconds: How long an out-of-sight room must be continuously occupied before it counts as refuge.
data_description.min_block_seconds: Never start a light block shorter than this; avoids end-of-day dribble.
data_description.refuge_hold_seconds: How long confirmed refuge survives gaps in the evidence — covers sensor decay while fetching coffee.
data_description.exposure_grace_seconds: How long viewer activity is tolerated during refuge before the light cuts. Set to 0 for instant cuts even while working from home.
